properties.name: Pelusiac Branch
properties.source: Branch names and rough courses follow the classical seven-branch description (Herodotus, Strabo, Ptolemy) and the geoarchaeological reconstruction of Stanley & Warne (1993), Said (1993) and Bunbury & Lutley (2008); the lines here are hand-drawn approximations from memory. Eastern-most branch, ending at Pelusium.
